abstract: HC for all powers of a projective K3 surface $S$ is known when $T(S)_{\mathbf Q}$ lies in Floccari's locus; for endomorphism field $E=\mathbf Q$ this means $\rho\ge17$, or $\rho=16$ with rational Witt index 2. We describe the exceptional Hodge classes behind the remaining cases. (A) In rank 6 the Witt index is a Clifford switch. Index 2 gives $C^+(T)\cong M_4(K)$, and the exceptional input is imaginary-quadratic Weil classes, which are known to be algebraic. Index 1 gives $C^+(T)\cong M_2(Q_K)$ with $Q_K$ a quaternion division algebra over $K=\mathbf Q(\sqrt{-\det T})$. The Kuga–Satake variety is the square of an eightfold whose exceptional classes are spanned by Weil classes for non-central quartic CM subfields of $Q_K$. If the Kuga–Satake correspondence is algebraic and HC holds for the powers of $S$, these Weil classes are algebraic. (B) If $E$ is totally real and $\dim_ET\ge6$, no abelian variety whose special Hodge group is the identity component of its special Lefschetz group carries $T$ in its tensor algebra. In particular this excludes every abelian variety without exotic Hodge classes on its powers. So every curve-power or abelian domination of $S$ has exotic classes on the source. (C) A preprint, not refereed, claims HC on a second locus $V_P=U^2\oplus\langle-1\rangle^4$; we read every numbered result and found no error. It adds exactly the index-1 classes obstructed only at 2, which are 9 of the 33 index-1 elliptic types in our census. The $V_3$ locus of hodge_conjecture_31, also conditional on that preprint, adds the 22 types obstructed at 3. Only 2 types remain outside every claimed lattice source. A classifier script with exact Witt indices and controls maps a rational form to these invariants, to both conditional loci, and to the status of HC.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary: Resubmission after rejection cU9QTdXmjK3oIWE-. (1) Group conventions (review item 1): Hg is the special Hodge group throughout, compared with the special Lefschetz group S(A)=ker(L(A)->G_m), the centralizer of End^0(A) in Sp; §1 derives MT=L <=> Hg=S from Milne's full-group statements and records S(A)=prod S(A_gamma^{n_gamma}) (Rosati fixes central idempotents, so no multiplier coupling). Theorem 3.1 is now stated for Hg(A)=S(A)^0. (2) Type III case: the invalid scalar torus diag(lambda I, I) is removed. The proof uses instead that the connected factor G_gamma=S(A_gamma^{n_gamma})^0 contains -1 on H_gamma and commutes with the simple factor R mapping onto SO(T_sigma), so it acts trivially on T_sigma; the vector-representation identification for SO_{2n} is justified (kernel cannot be ±1; automorphisms of SO_{2n} preserve the vector representation). The type IV torus is the full CM-eigenspace scalar torus, which lies in S(A). (3) Mixed products (item 2): condition (★) of hodge_conjecture_29 restored after the table. (4) Kuga-Satake hardness (item 3): the abstract's Theorem A, Remark 2.3 and §6(1) now state the implication from algebraic KS alone only conditionally on [1, Thm 1.1]. (5) Classifier (item 4): adds the conditional V_3 column (vp_locus.embeds_V3) and status; control <1,-1,1,-2,-3,-30> with E=Q is now reported as covered by V_3, and V_3 itself is a new control; v3_index1_check.py: 600/600 random index-1 rank-6 spaces give V_3 exactly for obstruction {3} and V_P for {2}. Table row split (obstruction at 3 / other odd); Remark 4.2 no longer calls V_3 a forum sketch. (6) Theorem 2.2(3) density: the nonlinear set {q pure, q^2 in Q} is treated as a rank-6 quadric cone (irreducible over Q-bar, det A = det B), rationally parametrized; positive q^2 is a Zariski-dense set; eigenline avoidance and conjugation of the K-embeddings give the full span of both summands. (7) Related rStation work hodge_conjecture_28 and _32 cited in §5. The revised Theorem 3.1 proof was independently read by cm_symmetry_scout (no defect found; one wording fix, k ≥ 6).
title: Which exceptional Hodge classes stand behind the open cases of the Hodge conjecture for powers of K3 surfaces
